The power requirements for the Ibanez Tube King TK999HT pedal are an Included AC-AC Adapter and a current consumption of 400mA maximum (AC12V). For more information, see page 16 of the manual. Read more Was this helpful? Yes No What kind of distortion sound does the Ibanez Tube King TK999HT produce? The Ibanez Tube King TK999HT produces a modern and aggressive tube distortion. It is configured with a scooped mid-range and is voiced with a tight low-end, ensuring the heaviest tube sound. For more information, see page 4 of the manual. Read more Was this helpful? Yes No Why is my Ibanez Tube King TK999HT pedal not turning on? If the pedal is not turning on, it could be due to issues with the AC adaptor. Using an incorrect AC adaptor may cause serious irreparable damage, malfunctions, noise, or fire. Additionally, the device contains high-voltage components, and touching them may produce electrical shock. For more information, see page 4 of the manual. Read more Was this helpful? Yes No How do I connect the Ibanez Tube King TK999HT to my amplifier? To connect the Ibanez Tube King TK999HT, connect your guitar to the pedal and the pedal to your amplifier. Before making connections, either switch off the amplifier or reduce its volume to the minimum level to prevent hearing loss and possible amplifier or speaker damage. For more information, see page 4 of the manual. Read more Was this helpful? Yes No Need help? Do you have a question about the Tube King Distortion TK999HT and is the answer not in the manual?
